scripts.predev: npm run db:ensure -w coretex && npm run build -w coretex
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "brain,web,desktop" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w coretex" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.dev:relays: concurrently --names "web,desktop" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.dev:webbrain: concurrently --names "brain,web" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev:tsx -w coretex" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently --names "brain,desktop" --prefix-colors "yellow,magenta" "npm run dev -w coretex" "npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w coretex && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w coretex && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run release:prepare && npm run electron:build -w apps/desktop
